description: This file defines a React functional component 'PromptsPanel' responsible for managing and displaying prompts, including features like fetching prompts from an API, adding, editing, deleting prompts, and conditional rendering of different views.

methods.name: fetchPrompts
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the list of prompts from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: handlePromptClick
methods.description: Sets the selected prompt ID when a prompt is clicked.

methods.name: handleAddPrompt
methods.description: Prepares the component to add a new prompt, resetting relevant state.

methods.name: handleEditPrompt
methods.description: Prepares the component to edit an existing prompt by setting prompt data.

methods.name: handleAddPromptFromFile
methods.description: Opens the modal to upload a prompt file.

methods.name: handleSuccess
methods.description: Refreshes the prompt list and resets editing state upon successful create/edit.

methods.name: handleDeleteClick
methods.description: Sets the prompt to be deleted based on user interaction.

methods.name: handleDeleteConfirm
methods.description: Confirms prompt deletion, calls API, updates UI, and shows notifications.

methods.name: handleDeleteCancel
methods.description: Cancels/deletes the delete prompt dialog without action.
